about.title: About Me

about.background: With a finance background, I've evolved into a data specialist with 7+ years of experience across different data and systems positions. I combine business acumen with technical expertise to deliver end-to-end solutions.

about.industriesStatement: Data skills transcend industry boundaries. Whether it's accounting transactions, credit risk models, IoT device logs, or social media analytics - the tools and techniques remain fundamentally similar. I apply proven data patterns across distinct domains, while understanding the specific business context and needs.
